logic: The donor's sync manifest and chunks that GET /api/donations/me/sync and GET /api/donations/me/sync/chunks?ids= answer to input.donor, joined: each chunk of the manifest with its id, rowsSha256 and count, and the rows the chunks endpoint answers for it. Every chunk the manifest lists is specified. Besides donations:<year> (below), a case whose rows hold them has receipts:<year>, the donor's receipts of the year a receipt certifies (a single receipt by its gift's year), newest issued first, each with its state and the receipt the issuer froze, so a change to a receipt text rewrites these rows; bank-accounts, the donor's bank account links; and symbol-claims, the donor's answers about older symbols. Input.receipts names the receipts issued over these rows; the backend runner issues them in that order through the donor's own issuer with the server clock at each issuedAt (the signing key and the signatory chosen first), so their numbers and states are the real issuer's and a yearly receipt replaces the single receipts of its gifts. A chunk donations:<year> holds the donor's donations received in that year, refunded ones too, newest first (receivedAt, then the newer record, then the higher id), and a year without any has no chunk; chunks are listed by id. rowsSha256 is the SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the UTF-8 bytes of the rows array written as RFC 8785 canonical JSON (members sorted by name, no whitespace, integers only), so each side computes it from the rows of the case itself. Ids are the aliases of the case's rows (donor:<alias>, donation:<n> for the n-th donation of input.donations); a runner replaces the real ids of its answer by them and computes rowsSha256 over the rows as aliased, after checking that the answer's own rowsSha256 is that SHA-256 of the rows it answered. The summary is the donor-summary computation (count, total, last day and per year over the RECEIVED donations), the receipt years (yearlyReceiptsAvailableThrough is the last completed year in Prague at now, receiptsAvailableFrom the setting RECEIPT_FIRST_YEAR) and bankDataAsOf, the last successful bank import (input.bankDataAsOf, written as bank_import_state.last_succeeded_at, or no import yet). The rows hold only the columns the computation reads: a runner fills every other column with any valid value; a donation with a payment is paired by its variable symbol, one without is recorded by hand.
